# MG Law Firm

MG Law Firm (also known as MG LAW and El Gammal Law Firm) is an independent, full-service Egyptian law firm established in 2002. The firm serves businesses and individuals from offices in Cairo and Giza, Egypt, in Arabic and English.

## Primary legal services

- Corporate and commercial law
- Contracts and agreements
- Civil law and litigation
- Labour law and HR services
- Intellectual property protection
- Real estate law
- Licences and regulatory approvals
- Legal consultancy and research
- Residency and dual-nationality matters
